utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina, I'm glad you're here. I wanted to confirm the details for the repair drive—do you have any items you'd like to bring?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do we have extra cables and power supplies? I was going to check the online inventory.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good question, Mina. I think we have some spares, but let me double-check the inventory list to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, Leo's organizing it, and I'm helping sort donations on Saturday. You should bring any broken items you have!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, Saturday sounds good—I've got a broken lamp I've been meaning to fix. I'll bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I'll look out for your lamp. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Kira, are you coming to the repair drive this weekend? I'm planning to bring my old toaster, but I'm still waiting on the exact times from the organizers.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You sure they've got the right parts for that toaster? I don't want to haul my stuff over only to find out it's a waste of time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I get your concern, but I think they've got a good variety of parts. I'll ask about that when I get the times.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Faye, are you planning to join the repair drive this weekend? I've been rallying some neighbors and could use your help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Actually, I just heard it's been moved to Sunday. Works better for me with the school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, really? I thought it was still Saturday. I'll need to double-check with Hana to confirm the new time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I'll mark it on my map then.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Actually, just a heads up—it's on Sunday now, not Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sunday? Thanks for the heads up, I'll update my map right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Quinn, you going to the repair drive? I think it's Saturday morning, but I can't remember if it's 9 or 10.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Noah! Yeah, I'm going. It starts at 9 AM sharp at the community center. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, 9 AM it is! I'll bring some donuts. Jules said some book club folks might come, so that'll be good.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, let me know when you hear back from Hana.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Leo. I'll wait to hear from you then.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Pia, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend at the community center? They're fixing broken electronics and appliances for free!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I heard! But I'm a bit worried about whether they'll have the right cables and power supplies. We should check the online inventory.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Good idea, Pia! Let's check it out right now on my phone—I can pull it up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Saturday morning at the center, right?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, Saturday morning. Hana said she'd add my broken chair to the list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I'll bring some tools. See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Rey, are you planning to join the repair drive this Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, I'm planning to go. I'm actually helping Cleo put up flyers for it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's great, thanks for helping spread the word! Do you need any more flyers?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Nell, are you planning to go to the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I'm definitely planning to go! I've got a broken toaster I'm hoping they can fix.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh great, a toaster! I heard they're good with small appliances. Maybe I'll bring my old blender.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sure, how about we meet tomorrow morning at the community center to update them?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good. I'll bring my toolbox and we can go through the list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's perfect, Gus! Let's aim for 9 AM, that way we have plenty of time before the flyer run.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds good! How about we meet at my place tomorrow morning to update them?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, tomorrow morning works for me. What time?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: How about 10 AM? That way we have the afternoon to put them up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, I'll try to make it on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, Bo. I'll see you there—hopefully I'll be on time this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Ha, I hear you. See you then—if I'm not running late myself.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It's a community event where people bring broken items to get fixed together. I think it's Saturday morning at the community center. Are you interested?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive! That sounds great—I think I have a toaster that's been acting up. What time does it start on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm not sure of the exact time yet, but I know it's Saturday morning. I'll let you know when I find out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, Nell mentioned it. I can bring some tools along to help out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: My chair's still waiting, but I'm glad you're bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Uli. We'll get that chair sorted soon—I'll bring some extra wrenches just in case.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, Saturday at the community center is confirmed. Let's focus on the inventory first, though.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good to know it's Saturday. But I still need the exact start time and how to sign up before I can commit.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: The start time is 10 AM, and you can sign up at the community center's front desk or online. Let's get back to the inventory now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We're fixing appliances at the community center this weekend. Bring any broken items.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I've got the community center down for Saturday. I'll be there with my map.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. See you Saturday at 9 AM.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Quinn, have you heard about the repair drive happening this Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I'm already helping spread the word! I'll have flyers printed by Saturday. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks for spreading the word! If you need any help handing out flyers, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Ira, have you heard about the repair drive? It's been moved to Sunday, but we still need help with the flyers.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sunday, huh? That's a shift. I can grab some flyers to pass around if you still need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be great, Ira! I'll have the updated flyers ready; want to swing by my place tomorrow evening to pick some up?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good idea, let's head to the garage and check the bin.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure, let's go! I think there might be some leftover supplies from last year's drive in there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, let's see what's in here.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Hana, are you free this Saturday morning? We're having a repair drive at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I'll be there Saturday morning—I'm helping coordinate, so I'll be around all day.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I'm glad you'll be there all day. I'll see you Saturday morning then!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Tess, you coming to the repair drive Saturday? It's at the community center, 9 to noon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I thought it was from 10 to 4 – Nell told me that. But if it's 9 to noon, I'll be there early to help set up!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, Nell had it wrong. It's definitely 9 to noon. Glad you can make it early!
